QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Enemy At The Gates
QuestInfo.0: You were able to hold the walls, but the situation doesn't look good. The Head Security Officer looks like he's losing it. Ask him what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: The Vikings have shifted their attack to the rear gates. The Head Security Officer needs your help keeping them out.
QuestInfo.2: The castle's rear gates are safe for now. However, Violetta's knocking just about ruined everything.

0.0: We've just received word that the Vikings are charging the main gates. We must stop them from breaking our defensive line! That's what happened last time with the Pepes, I think.

yes.0: We have no time to waste! Please go to the #b#m106031200##k and stop the Vikings. Hurry!

no.0: Stop it... You're going to give me flashbacks if you don't help!

default.0: Once they get through the gates, everything is over! Over! Just like last time... Please go to the rear gates to stop the vikings!
